credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Tish Frank and Georgia O'Keeffe sitting on the shore, O'Keeffe is wearing her black wide brimmed hat, a jacket and shirt and her PF Flyer sneakers. Frank is wearing sunglasses, white shirt, pants and white sneakers.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Tish Frank and Georgia O'Keeffe Sitting on Shore
